caption: Longer-range missile model phase 3: suppression morale floor and ammunition. Player skirmishers engage an enemy heavy infantry formation (locked shield wall, melee-only) from standoff reach. Under fire without the ability to reply, the infantry formation's morale erodes toward the suppression floor (50.0 / shaken threshold) where it flattens without routing unaided. Units track missile ammunition and halt firing when empty.
